visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white t-shirt stands inside an American-style restaurant, holding a smartphone to record his own video. He claps his hands together to mark the start of the challenge. The background features retro signage such as 'BURGER DREAM' and 'GOOD MEAL'. (2) The main character, a young man with black-rimmed glasses and a dark grey t-shirt, sits at a table wearing black disposable gloves. He begins biting into a large burger while a massive tray of French fries and fried chicken sits before him. (3) Several close-up shots highlight the specific food items: a burger with a thick beef patty and green relish, another dripping with white cheese sauce, a large metal tray filled with seasoned fries, and numerous pieces of crispy golden-brown fried chicken. (4) The man is shown eating with great intensity, alternating between large bites of burgers and grabbing handfuls of French fries. A digital timer sits prominently on the table, displaying the remaining time as he continues his rapid consumption. (5) After finishing the food and drinking from a cup, the man celebrates by holding up several $500 Taiwan Dollar bills toward the camera. He has a broad, joyful smile, appearing satisfied with his accomplishment. (6) A final sequence shows a waiter in a white t-shirt carrying more food through the restaurant, followed by a text overlay providing the restaurant's address and a call to search for the creator's YouTube channel.
